name: Seika no Mori
source:
This is a visual novel with multiple scenarios, where the story changes depending upon your decisions. You will witness the love story of our hero Seiji Mizuno and his girlfriend Ayumi Takigawa. You will see their lives as circumstances evolve around them: The city and the country, as well as the past and the present. Please pay particular attention to the stage background brimming with emotion. 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20020817002639fw_/http://gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2001/sa/seika_no_mori/index.htm]gamelexgs[/url]]
translation:
这是一部拥有多条剧情路线的视觉小说，故事会随玩家的选择而改变。你将见证水野诚司与女友泷川步美的爱情故事，也会看到随着周遭环境变迁，他们在城市与乡村、过去与现在之间展开的人生。请特别留意那洋溢着情感的舞台背景。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20020817002639fw_/http://gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2001/sa/seika_no_mori/index.htm]gamelexgs[/url]]
